name: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk
summary: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, explores for and produces oil and gas in Indonesia, Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and the United Kingdom. It operates through Exploration and Production of Oil and Gas; Services; Power; Chemicals; and Trading segments. The company operates an independent power producer in the gas, geothermal, and other renewables sectors, as well as manages a portfolio of onshore and offshore assets in the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific.
